_title: California Community College General Education Advanced Placement (CCC GE AP) List
_source: AA 17-20 (CCCCO Educational Services, 2017-03-30), implementing AB 1985 (2016, Williams). FAQ clarifications: AA 17-33 (2017-06-16). Source docs committed at docs/reference/ccc_ap_credit_policy_AA17-20_2017.docx + ccc_ge_ap_policy_faqs_AA17-33_2017.docx.
_codification: Being codified + extended to other external standardized exams via CCR Title 5 Notice of Proposed Rulemaking 'Awarding Credit for Advanced Placement and Other External Standardized Examinations', 45-day notice published 2026-01-12 (docs/reference/ccr_title5_awarding_credit_ap_external_exams_45day_2026-01-12.pdf).
_ge_framework: title 5 §55063 'four divisions': Natural Sciences, Social/Behavioral Sciences, Humanities, Language and Rationality. Per the AA 17-33 FAQ, Humanities subsumes Arts (CSU GE separates them), so Music/Arts AP credit may be awarded in either.
_policy_notes: A score of 3, 4, or 5 is required for general-education certification.
Colleges shall award the indicated GE-Area credit AT A MINIMUM (may award more units, or additional/alternative credit).
If the college HAS a course similar in content to the exam, course credit is awarded for that course; if NOT, the student receives GE-Area certification.
Course-to-course AP credit is explicitly a LOCAL decision made by the appropriate discipline faculty — it is NOT set by this statewide list. Local course titles vary; the GE Area does not.

N/A = no GE Area fits the exam; the college MAY award elective credit. This is the documented origin of the 'elective bucket' pattern in MAP CPL data (a single local course mapped to many exams for generic elective credit).
_usage: Consumed by export_credential_reference() in excel_to_dashboard.py: each CER credential whose unified_title is an AP exam is joined to its system-level GE-Area credit via the normalized exam name + the per-exam `aliases` (CER uses modern College Board names; the 2017 policy uses older ones). Match key = the title with the 'AP '/'Advanced Placement ' prefix stripped, '&'->'and', lowercased, non-alphanumerics->spaces, collapsed.

exams.note: Per the AA 17-33 FAQ, may also be awarded in Arts (title 5 combines Humanities + Arts).

_unmapped_cer_titles_note: These CER AP titles are NOT on the 2017 list (newer or discontinued College Board exams) so they carry no GE-Area mapping until the 2026 NPRM / an updated list is sourced: AP African American Studies, AP Computer Science AB, AP French Literature, AP Latin Literature, AP Physics, AP Physics B, AP Precalculus.
